(async()=>{await document.fonts.load('42px "H2O2 Macintosh"','H2O2');await document.fonts.ready;const maker=document.querySelector('.maker-name');if(maker.href!=='https://github.com/28H2O2')throw Error('Maker URL');if(document.querySelectorAll('.chapter-nav a').length!==3)throw Error('Missing chapter');if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth)throw Error('Parent overflow');for(const id of ['overview-frame','waterway-frame','urinal-frame']){const f=document.getElementById(id),d=f.contentDocument;if(d.documentElement.scrollWidth>f.clientWidth+1)throw Error(id+' overflow');if(f.clientHeight<d.querySelector('.iso-page').getBoundingClientRect().bottom-2)throw Error(id+' clipped')}const d=document.getElementById('urinal-frame').contentDocument;d.querySelector('button[data-step="3"]').click();if(d.querySelector('#u-main').textContent!=='开启')throw Error('Embedded controls fail');const w=document.getElementById('waterway-frame').contentDocument;w.querySelector('button[data-phase="3"]').click();if(!w.querySelector('.water-layout'))throw Error('Waterway missing');return {width:innerWidth,chapters:3,fontLoaded:document.fonts.check('42px "H2O2 Macintosh"'),heights:[...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].map(f=>f.clientHeight)};})()
